title: What happened in AI — Oct 17, 2026
intro: DeepSeek dominated the day: standalone Search and Fetch APIs at about $0.75 per 1,000 calls, plus the V4.1-Flash-1017 model aimed at cheaper agentic tasks.
Elsewhere, builders got new open tools for sandboxing, cleaning up, and replaying agents, and Meta's moves reignited talk of US open weights.
highlights: DeepSeek launches Search and Fetch APIs for agents at 5 yuan (~$0.75) per 1,000 calls.
DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 reportedly beats larger rivals on agentic tasks at lower per-task cost.
V4.1-Flash is tied more tightly to DeepSeek's own harness.
Nono, Baa and Agentfork add kernel-level boundaries, process cleanup and step-level replay for agents.
Reverse Engineer Anything links Claude Code and Codex to Ghidra, Hopper and IDA.
